blocks.text: Although the metadata still carries the previous episode title, the page is really a direct portrait of the siege conditions at Gurdaspur. As it prevailed at Gurdaspur, hunger had reduced them to skeletons and even the smallest morsel of bread became an object of desperate contention.

When scraps appeared, the famished Singhs pounced on them with the urgency of men already standing at the edge of death. Their bodies were exhausted, yet the Mughal camp still feared Banda Singh and did not treat the starving garrison as harmless captives.

The page holds together two truths at once: extreme bodily collapse and continuing moral terror. Even in famine the besieged Panth remained formidable enough that the enemy hesitated before the leader it had already surrounded.
